segments.name: Battery Solutions for Electric Commercial Vehicles
segments.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures high-performance lithium-ion battery solutions for electric commercial vehicles with ultra-fast charging and extended cycle life.
segments.evidence: We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance battery solutions for light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks, buses, trains, mining trucks, marine and port vehicles, automated guided vehicles, and specialty vehicles.

segments.name: Energy Storage Systems
segments.description: Develops and manufactures battery solutions for grid infrastructure, providing capacity support and grid resiliency for renewable energy and data center applications.
segments.evidence: We believe energy storage is now a critical component of grid infrastructure.

segments.name: Battery Components
segments.description: Develops and manufactures critical lithium-ion battery components including cathode, anode, electrolyte, and separator for internal use and external sale.
segments.evidence: As a vertically integrated battery company, Microvast develops and owns proprietary intellectual property and know-how relating to the design, development, and manufacture of the four critical components of lithium-ion batteries: cathode, anode, electrolyte, and separator.

revenueModel.text: The company sells battery solutions and components to original equipment manufacturers in commercial vehicle and energy storage industries.
revenueModel.evidence: We have primarily supplied our battery solutions to OEMs for use in electric commercial and specialty vehicles.
